name: Ruou can
summary: Rượu cần is the Hre rice wine of Ba Tơ: upland sticky rice fermented with forest-leaf yeast in a clay jar and drunk from the jar when guests arrive. It tastes sweet and strong.
culture: ZaloPay says Hre communities in Ba Tơ serve the jar at gatherings.
taste: ZaloPay calls the jar sweetly strong.
howToEat: ZaloPay: yeast from forest leaves, upland sticky rice, fermented in a clay jar, drunk from the jar when a guest is received.
The provincial introduction names rượu cần beside rượu đót in the mountains.
seoTitle: Ruou can — the jar in Ba To
seoDescription: Rượu cần in Ba Tơ, the Hre jar wine of upland sticky rice and forest-leaf yeast, shared from the jar with guests.
